DEVELOPER BETA · V0.2.2

Try it on your own tabs.

This is the early testing route. You need desktop Chrome and permission to use developer mode. Keep the extracted folder on your computer for as long as you use this beta.

Download extension ZIP ↓Checksums ↓
  1. Download and unzip.Extract skim-extension.zip. The folder named skim-extension contains manifest.json.
  2. Open Chrome’s extensions page.Paste chrome://extensions in the address bar. Turn on Developer mode.
  3. Load the folder.Click Load unpacked and choose the extracted skim-extension folder. The welcome page should open.
  4. Try one paragraph.Use the practice page, then pin Skim from Chrome’s puzzle-piece menu. Open an article or AI reply, click Skim, and start Pointer mode.
  5. Remember the sites you choose.Choose Remember on this site and approve that site once. Skim will return there. The extension’s settings let you pause or forget it.

Unpacked builds do not update automatically. Download a newer beta, replace its files, and click Reload in chrome://extensions. The store release will use Chrome’s updater.

What you’re installing

The extension

A pointer-driven reading lens, top-of-page dock, per-site opt-in, and a local reader. No camera, account, subscription, or AI API key.

The separate gaze lab

An experimental web page using webcam estimates after consent and calibration. It does not follow your eyes across websites or across macOS apps.

Skim preserves source wording. Its local heuristics can pick an unhelpful sentence, and emphasizing a claim does not verify it. English prose is the primary beta target. Protected browser pages, PDFs, some embedded frames, and unusual page layouts are not supported.

Built in the open.

The source is available under GPL-3.0-only. The complete project includes the extension, website, tests, packaging scripts, and an optional local Jev adapter for developers.
